title: सप्तनवत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 297 · The prince and the sage in the forest

summary.en: Bhishma tells of a prince of Janaka's line who, hunting in a lonely forest, met a sage of the line of Bhrigu. The sage tells him that it is hard to do pure deeds without good, and easy to do them with good, and that sin takes great effort to wipe away, and the prince turns his mind from desire to dharma.
summary.kn: ಜನಕವಂಶದ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರ ನಿರ್ಜನ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇಟೆಯಾಡುವಾಗ ಭೃಗುವಂಶದ ಋಷಿಯನ್ನು ಭೇಟಿಯಾದುದನ್ನು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಋಷಿ ಶುದ್ಧ ಕರ್ಮ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಕಷ್ಟ, ಪಾಪ ತೊಳೆಯಲು ಬಹಳ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಬೇಕೆಂದು ಹೇಳಿದಾಗ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರ ಕಾಮದಿಂದ ಮನಸ್ಸು ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ ಧರ್ಮದತ್ತ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीष्म जनक वंश के एक राजकुमार की कथा कहते हैं जो सूने वन में शिकार करते हुए भृगुवंश के एक ऋषि से मिला। ऋषि बताते हैं कि शुद्ध कर्म करना कठिन और पाप धोना बड़े प्रयास का कार्य है, और राजकुमार काम से मन हटाकर धर्म में लगाता है।
summary.te: జనక వంశపు రాజకుమారుడు నిర్జన అడవిలో వేటాడుతూ భృగు వంశపు ఋషిని కలిసిన కథను భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు. పవిత్ర కర్మ చేయడం కష్టమని, పాపం కడగడానికి గొప్ప ప్రయత్నం కావాలని ఋషి చెప్పగా రాజకుమారుడు కామం నుండి మనసు మళ్లించి ధర్మం వైపు తిరుగుతాడు.
summary.ta: ஜனக குலத்து இளவரசன் வெறிச்சோடிய காட்டில் வேட்டையாடும்போது பிருகு குல முனிவரைச் சந்தித்த கதையைப் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார். தூய செயல் செய்வது கடினம், பாவத்தைக் கழுவ பெரும் முயற்சி வேண்டும் என்று முனிவர் கூற, இளவரசன் ஆசையிலிருந்து மனத்தைத் திருப்பித் தர்மத்தை நாடுகிறான்.
summary.ml: ജനകവംശത്തിലെ ഒരു രാജകുമാരൻ ഏകാന്ത വനത്തിൽ വേട്ടയാടുമ്പോൾ ഭൃഗുവംശത്തിലെ ഒരു മുനിയെ കണ്ടതിന്റെ കഥ ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു. നല്ല ഗുണമില്ലാതെ ശുദ്ധമായ പ്രവൃത്തി ചെയ്യുന്നത് പ്രയാസമാണെന്നും, നല്ല ഗുണത്തോടെ അത് എളുപ്പമാണെന്നും, പാപം തുടച്ചുനീക്കാൻ വലിയ പരിശ്രമം വേണമെന്നും മുനി പറയുന്നു; രാജകുമാരൻ ആഗ്രഹത്തിൽനിന്ന് മനസ്സ് ധർമ്മത്തിലേക്ക് തിരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.297; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
मृगयां विचरन्कश्चिद्विजने जनकात्मजः ।
वने ददर्श विप्रेन्द्रमृषिं वंशधरं भृगोः ॥

meaning.en: A certain son of Janaka, wandering on a hunt in a lonely forest, saw a sage there, a foremost brahmin and a descendant of Bhrigu.

verses.text:
तमासीनमुपासीनः प्रणम्य शिरसा मुनिम् ।
पश्चादनुमतस्तेन पप्रच्छ वसुमानिदम् ॥

meaning.en: Bowing his head to the seated sage, Vasuman sat near him, and afterwards, with the sage's leave, asked him this.

verses.text:
भगवन्किमिदं श्रेयः प्रेत्य वापीह वा भवेत् ।
पुरुषस्याध्रुवे देहे कामस्य वशवर्तिनः ॥

meaning.en: "Revered sir, what is the highest good for a man in this impermanent body, who is under the sway of desire, whether after death or here?"

verses.text:
सत्कृत्य परिपृष्टः सन्सुमहात्मा महातपाः ।
निजगाद ततस्तस्मै श्रेयस्करमिदं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Honored and questioned, the great-souled sage of great austerity then spoke to him these words that bring the highest good.

verses.text:
मनसोऽप्रतिकूलानि प्रेत्य चेह च वाञ्छसि ।
भूतानां प्रतिकूलेभ्यो निवर्तस्व यतेन्द्रियः ॥

meaning.en: "You wish for what is agreeable to the mind both after death and here; so, with senses controlled, turn away from what is harmful to beings."

verses.text:
धर्मः सतां हितः पुंसां धर्मश्चैवाश्रयः सताम् ।
धर्माल्लोकास्त्रयस्तात प्रवृत्ताः सचराचराः ॥

meaning.en: "Dharma is the good of good people, and dharma is their refuge; from dharma, dear one, the three worlds with all that moves and stands have come forth."

verses.text:
स्वादुकामुक कामानां वैतृष्ण्यं किं न गच्छसि ।
मधु पश्यसि दुर्बुद्धे प्रपातं नानुपश्यसि ॥

meaning.en: "You who are fond of sweets and given to desires, why do you not reach freedom from craving? Foolish one, you see the honey but do not see the fall."

verses.text:
यथा ज्ञाने परिचयः कर्तव्यस्तत्फलार्थिना ।
तथा धर्मे परिचयः कर्तव्यस्तत्फलार्थिना ॥

meaning.en: "As one who wants the fruit of knowledge must practice learning, so one who wants the fruit of dharma must practice dharma."

verses.text:
असता धर्मकामेन विशुद्धं कर्म दुष्करम् ।
सता तु धर्मकामेन सुकरं कर्म दुष्करम् ॥

meaning.en: "For one who is not good but wants dharma, pure action is hard; but for one who is good and wants dharma, though action is easy, it is also hard."

verses.text:
वने ग्राम्यसुखाचारो यथा ग्राम्यस्तथैव सः ।
ग्रामे वनसुखाचारो यथा वनचरस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: "One who follows village pleasures in the forest is just a villager, and one who follows forest pleasures in the village is just a forest-dweller."

verses.text:
मनोवाक्कर्मके धर्मे कुरु श्रद्धां समाहितः ।
निवृत्तौ वा प्रवृत्तौ वा संप्रधार्य गुणागुणान् ॥

meaning.en: "Have faith, with a collected mind, in dharma of thought, word and deed, having weighed the merits and faults of withdrawal and of engagement."

verses.text:
नित्यं च बहु दातव्यं साधुभ्यश्चानसूयता ।
प्रार्थितं व्रतशौचाभ्यां सत्कृतं देशकालयोः ॥

meaning.en: "Always give generously to the good without resentment, to those who ask, who are devoted to vows and purity, honoring them with attention to place and time."

verses.text:
शुभेन विधिना लब्धमर्हाय प्रतिपादयेत् ।
क्रोधमुत्सृज्य दत्त्वा च नानुतप्येन्न कीर्तयेत् ॥

meaning.en: "What is gained by good means should be given to the worthy; having cast off anger and given, one should neither regret it nor boast of it."

verses.text:
अनृशंसः शुचिर्दान्तः सत्यवागार्जवे स्थितः ।
योनिकर्मविशुद्धश्च पात्रं स्याद्वेदविद्द्विजः ॥

meaning.en: "A brahmin who knows the Veda, kind, pure, self-controlled, truthful and upright, and pure in birth and deeds, is a worthy recipient."

verses.text:
सत्कृता चैकपत्नी च जात्या योनिरिहेष्यते ।
ऋग्यजुःसामगो विद्वान्षट्कर्मा पात्रमुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: "Her honored sole wife and her lineage are valued here by birth; one who knows the Rig, Yajur and Sama Vedas and performs the six duties is called a worthy recipient."

verses.text:
स एव धर्मः सोऽधर्मस्तं तं प्रतिनरं भवेत् ।
पात्रकर्मविशेषेण देशकालाववेक्ष्य च ॥

meaning.en: "The very same thing is dharma or adharma for different people, according to the recipient and the act, looking at place and time."

verses.text:
लीलयाल्पं यथा गात्रात्प्रमृज्याद्रजसः पुमान् ।
बहुयत्नेन महता पापनिर्हरणं तथा ॥

meaning.en: "As a man may wipe a little dust off his body playfully, so the removal of sin needs great effort."

verses.text:
विरिक्तस्य यथा सम्यग्घृतं भवति भेषजम् ।
तथा निर्हृतदोषस्य प्रेत्यधर्मः सुखावहः ॥

meaning.en: "As ghee becomes a proper medicine for one who has been purged, so dharma brings happiness hereafter to one whose faults have been removed."

verses.text:
मानसं सर्वभूतेषु वर्तते वै शुभाशुभे ।
अशुभेभ्यः समाक्षिप्य शुभेष्वेवावतारयेत् ॥

meaning.en: "The mind of all beings acts in good and evil; draw it away from the evil and set it only on the good."

verses.text:
सर्वं सर्वेण सर्वत्र क्रियमाणं च पूजय ।
स्वधर्मे यत्र रागस्ते कामं धर्मो विधीयताम् ॥

meaning.en: "Honor everything done by everyone everywhere; and wherever your fondness is, in your own dharma, let dharma be practiced as you like."

verses.text:
अधृतात्मन्धृतौ तिष्ठ दुर्बुद्धे बुद्धिमान्भव ।
अप्रशान्त प्रशाम्य त्वमप्राज्ञ प्राज्ञवच्चर ॥

meaning.en: "Unsteady one, stand firm in steadiness; foolish one, become wise; restless one, be calm; unlearned one, act like the learned."

verses.text:
तेजसा शक्यते प्राप्तुमुपायसहचारिणा ।
इह च प्रेत्य च श्रेयस्तस्य मूलं धृतिः परा ॥

meaning.en: "It can be won by energy accompanied by right means; the root of the good here and hereafter is supreme steadiness."

verses.text:
राजर्षिरधृतिः स्वर्गात्पतितो हि महाभिषः ।
ययातिः क्षीणपुण्यश्च धृत्या लोकानवाप्तवान् ॥

meaning.en: "The royal sage Mahabhisha fell from heaven through lack of steadiness, and Yayati, his merit exhausted, regained the worlds through steadiness."

verses.text:
तपस्विनां धर्मवतां विदुषां चोपसेवनात् ।
प्राप्स्यसे विपुलां बुद्धिं तथा श्रेयोऽभिपत्स्यसे ॥

meaning.en: "By serving ascetics, the righteous and the learned, you will gain wide understanding and will reach the good."

verses.text:
स तु स्वभावसंपन्नस्तच्छ्रुत्वा मुनिभाषितम् ।
विनिवर्त्य मनः कामाद्धर्मे बुद्धिं चकार ह ॥

meaning.en: Being of good nature, having heard the sage's words, he turned his mind from desire and set his understanding on dharma.
